```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-sdr735-floorplan
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Floorplan of the SDR735 cellular transceiver (5.41 mm × 4.12 mm), redrawn from an analysis of a die photo. The block boundaries are approximate; the colors group the blocks by function."
import re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

W, H = 5.41, 4.12      # die size in mm
# blocks as (x0, y0, x1, y1) in fractions of the die, measured from the top-left
# corner of the die photo, (label, function)
blocks = [
    ((0.003, 0.005, 0.167, 0.266), 'TX0\n4 RF\nchains', 'tx'),
    ((0.170, 0.005, 0.222, 0.101), 'bias', 'bias'),
    ((0.170, 0.101, 0.222, 0.266), 'DACs', 'conv'),
    ((0.240, 0.005, 0.378, 0.220), 'control\nCPU', 'dig'),
    ((0.378, 0.065, 0.583, 0.243), 'control\nlogic', 'dig'),
    ((0.483, 0.005, 0.583, 0.065), 'HS I/O', 'io'),
    ((0.587, 0.005, 0.767, 0.243), 'digital', 'dig'),
    ((0.778, 0.005, 0.819, 0.101), 'bias', 'bias'),
    ((0.778, 0.101, 0.819, 0.280), 'DACs', 'conv'),
    ((0.819, 0.005, 0.997, 0.280), 'TX1\n4 RF\nchains', 'tx'),
    ((0.049, 0.271, 0.222, 0.459), 'TX0 PLL\n3 VCOs', 'pll'),
    ((0.222, 0.248, 0.278, 0.459), 'bias', 'bias'),
    ((0.285, 0.248, 0.476, 0.459), 'digital', 'dig'),
    ((0.476, 0.285, 0.813, 0.459), 'RX DSP', 'dig'),
    ((0.816, 0.285, 0.993, 0.459), 'TX1 PLL\n2 VCOs', 'pll'),
    ((0.003, 0.464, 0.167, 0.711), 'feedback\nRX', 'rx'),
    ((0.003, 0.716, 0.167, 0.995), 'GNSS RX\ndual\nband', 'rx'),
    ((0.181, 0.491, 0.240, 0.606), 'IQ\nADC', 'conv'),
    ((0.240, 0.491, 0.340, 0.606), 'bias', 'bias'),
    ((0.340, 0.491, 0.431, 0.606), '2 IQ\nADCs', 'conv'),
    ((0.434, 0.464, 0.542, 0.606), 'LS I/O\nclock\nPLLs', 'io'),
    ((0.542, 0.491, 0.632, 0.606), '2 IQ\nADCs', 'conv'),
    ((0.632, 0.491, 0.719, 0.606), '2 IQ\nADCs', 'conv'),
    ((0.719, 0.491, 0.813, 0.606), 'bias', 'bias'),
    ((0.813, 0.491, 0.903, 0.606), '2 IQ\nADCs', 'conv'),
    ((0.903, 0.491, 0.983, 0.606), '2 IQ\nADCs', 'conv'),
    ((0.240, 0.881, 0.983, 0.995), '20 RF inputs', 'rx'),
]
# ten receivers RX0 ... RX9 and three RX PLLs in the row above the RF inputs
row = (0.625, 0.872)
rx_x = [(0.181, 0.222), (0.222, 0.257), (0.389, 0.424), (0.424, 0.458), (0.458, 0.493),
        (0.493, 0.528), (0.703, 0.738), (0.738, 0.774), (0.774, 0.810), (0.944, 0.983)]
for i, (x0, x1) in enumerate(rx_x):
    blocks.append(((x0, row[0], x1, row[1]), f'RX{i}', 'rx'))
for (x0, x1), n, k in (((0.260, 0.386), 2, 0), ((0.531, 0.700), 3, 1), ((0.813, 0.941), 2, 2)):
    blocks.append(((x0, row[0], x1, row[1]), f'RX{k} PLL\n{n} VCOs', 'pll'))

colors = {'rx': '#9fc5e8', 'tx': '#f4b183', 'pll': '#b6d7a8', 'conv': '#ffe599',
          'dig': '#d9d2e9', 'bias': '#eeeeee', 'io': '#cccccc'}
names = {'rx': 'receivers', 'tx': 'transmitters', 'pll': 'PLLs and VCOs',
         'conv': 'data converters', 'dig': 'digital', 'bias': 'bias', 'io': 'I/O, clocks'}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 7.4))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), W, H, fc='white', ec='k', lw=2))
for (x0, y0, x1, y1), label, kind in blocks:
    xa, ya, w, h = x0 * W, (1 - y1) * H, (x1 - x0) * W, (y1 - y0) * H
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((xa, ya), w, h, fc=colors[kind], ec='k', lw=0.8))
    rot = 90 if re.fullmatch(r'RX\d', label) else 0
    ax.text(xa + w / 2, ya + h / 2, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, rotation=rot)

handles = [Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, fc=colors[k], ec='k', lw=0.8) for k in colors]
ax.legend(handles, [names[k] for k in colors], loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.09),
          ncol=4, fontsize=8, frameon=False)
ax.set_xlim(-0.05, W + 0.05)
ax.set_ylim(-0.05, H + 0.05)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.set_xlabel('mm')
ax.set_ylabel('mm')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
